'Shin Tennis no Oujisama: U-17 World Cup Kesshou Member Ketteisen' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, First Promo
The official website for the Shin Tennis no Oujisama: U-17 World Cup Kesshou Member Ketteisen television anime series revealed additional cast, new staff, a key visual (pictured), and the first promotional video on Friday. The sequel anime is scheduled to premiere on October 1 at 12.00 a.m. on TV Tokyo, followed by TV Osaka, and TV Aichi. Cast Julio Roman: Tasuku Hatanaka (Boku no Hero Academia) Mars de Colon: Reiji Kawashim (Kill Ao) Silva Serra Banbieri: Ryuuho Nagaoka (Tamon-kun Ima Docchi!?)...

'Katainaka no Ossan, Kensei ni Naru II' Unveils Additional Cast Pair, Fourth Promo
The official website for the television anime adaptation of Shigeru Sagazaki's Katainaka no Ossan Kensei ni Naru (From Old Country Bumpkin to Master Swordsman) light novel unveiled an additional pair of cast and a fourth promotional video for the second season on Friday. The anime series premiered on July 8 at 11.45 p.m. on TV Asahi, followed by AT-X and BS Asahi.
